title: ClearVoid GUI
description: A clean and modern Minecraft GUI texture pack focused on transparent glass-style interfaces and smooth aesthetics.
body:
🌟 Features

Glass GUI introduces a refined and modern interface with frosted glass-style inventories and menus, along with a clean transparent hotbar for better visibility. The design focuses on a minimal and modern aesthetic while maintaining smooth, Minecraft-style visuals. It is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring a simple yet elegant experience. Overall, it is designed to enhance cozy and cinematic gameplay without losing the original vanilla feel.

Glass GUI transforms Minecraft’s default interface into a cleaner, more immersive experience while preserving its classic look and usability. ✨
